title: Reunification Pathways, Contact Readiness & Return Home
description: SS-CURR-002: Guides parents through the reunification journey, understanding the child's experience of care, preparing for supervised and unsupervised contact visits, learning from feedback, and sustaining Home Again transitions.
outcomes: Understand child safety expectations, parent rights, goals, and the child's emotional experience of placement and transitions
Prepare for family contact visits with child-centred activities, emotional regulation, and constructive use of visit feedback
Demonstrate sustained parenting change and maintain safe, predictable routines during return-home transitions
